description:
Work at Blissway: Opportunity for Impact Every Day 🚀✨

Blissway is a startup that simplifies toll collection and dramatically improves highway safety. We are multiple startups in one: Deep Tech, AI/ML, Hardware, SaaS, and IoT. For the past five years, we have built a nearly insurmountable technological lead in tolling, a roughly $200B global industry expected to double in the next decade. We work for toll authorities and state DOTs, and we own the whole system, from the roadside camera to the final bill, so every vehicle we see becomes one accurate toll transaction and nothing more. While our competitors have thousands of employees, we operate with a lean but growing team of less than 30. Our impact is visible on the massive Interstate Highway System connecting every major US metro (except Juneau, AK—sorry, Juneau).

The Mission: Every image on our system has one job: complete an accurate toll transaction through a billing system we run and audit ourselves. Your job is keeping the models behind that transaction accurate and reliable. We process 11 million images a day, using detection, segmentation, classification, embeddings, and re-identification to match each vehicle to its toll. You'll own the infrastructure, deployment, and monitoring that take a model to the road, and the updates that keep it correct once it's there. This role is for the engineer who sees a great model stuck in a notebook and can't rest until it's running reliably in production.



The Work

 - Own training and serving infrastructure, model versioning, deployment and rollback on servers we run ourselves.

 - Decide how models get to roadside devices and stay updated there.

 - Build monitoring that catches model drift before anyone else does, and ship the fixes.



How We Handle Data
We work only for toll authorities and state DOTs, on legislatively authorized toll roads. The laws governing our work prohibit keeping data unless it's used to charge a toll. There is no search-by-plate interface, no cross-agency lookup network, and no standing law enforcement access. Data leaves our system only through the same legal process that applies to any company's billing records.



You're a good fit if…

 - You want ownership: You'd rather own a whole problem than a small piece of one. If something's broken, you fix it. If something's missing, you build it. We're outcomes-focused, not hours-focused, and you know when the moment calls for an extra push.

 - You code really well: You're a strong software engineer first, fluent in Python. We also use TypeScript.

 - You're relentlessly curious: When something fails, you want to know why, not just that it's fixed, and you'll dig until you find out.

 - You see the whole system: You understand what problem you're solving, why it matters and how it connects to the rest, from camera to model to toll transaction.



Requirements

 - 2+ years of full-time software engineering, building and running production systems (infrastructure, backend services or ML platforms)

 - Production fundamentals: reliable pipelines, deployment, observability, and the tooling that keeps them running

 - Fluent in Python

 - You understand how models are trained and evaluated well enough to debug them in production, or you're a strong engineer eager to get there fast

 - Bonus: Taking models past the notebook (deployment, monitoring, retraining), deploying to edge or resource-constrained hardware, running your own servers instead of fully managed cloud services
   
   

Interview Process
We're selectively small, so every hire has outsized impact. That's why we're thorough: 3–4 interviews, then a paid on-site where you work with the team, scheduled around your current job. You get to know us as well as we get to know you, so you start with the trust and context to contribute from day one.

The Essentials (Health & Wealth)

 - Relocation Support: We are excited for you to join the team at our engineering office in Denver. We value in-person collaboration and daily team lunches and we provide a relocation bonus to help you get here.

 - Personalized Health Coverage (ICHRA): We don’t believe in one-size-fits-all healthcare. We provide a monthly allowance for you and dependents so you can choose the individual plan that actually fits your life.

 - Investing in Your Future: 401(k) matching up to 4%.

 - Peace of Mind: Transparent compensation. Company-sponsored life & disability insurance.

 - Early Stage Equity: Competitive equity package. Every year, we facilitate a tender process that gives you the opportunity to sell your vested shares at the same valuation as our investors.

Rest & Recharge 🌴

 - High-Trust Time Off: 4 weeks of untracked PTO. We don't micromanage your calendar; we focus on your impact. Take the time you need to stay sharp and inspired.

 - Family First: 12 weeks of paid parental leave for birth and adoptive parents. We want you present for the moments that matter most.

 - The Deep Breath (Sabbatical): Every 5 years, take 12 weeks of fully paid leave. Go travel, write a book, or master a new hobby—then come back and tell us all about it.

Fuel & Community 😀

 - The Blissway Kitchen: Whether it’s breakfast to start your day or our daily group lunches, we keep the team fueled.

 - Snacks Autonomy: Our kitchen is fully stocked and we mean it—if we’re missing your favorite fuel, just add it to the request list.

 - The "BlissTrip": An annual 4-day getaway for the team and significant others.

 - Monthly Beats: Game nights, escape rooms, and dinners to celebrate the grit we put in.

 - Continuous Learning: Tuition reimbursement for courses, programs, and conferences that sharpen your craft.
